name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
label: Quest
description: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I will get started immediately on crafting your orb and infusing your new demon into it. When done, you will have the choice of having it in the form of a staff or orb. I always felt it was important to cater to a warlock's chosen weapon... I see no reason not to continue that practice.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is done, friend. Simply tell me which you'd prefer: a staff that would require you to use both hands, or an orb so you may use a dagger or sword as your weapon.
Tackling a felhound was a great feat on your part. I am sure your item will serve you well in the future. Continue to work hard in the arts, friend. I will be awaiting details of your exploits.
